description: This file defines a custom throttler guard class for rate limiting API requests, including handling API keys, OAuth clients, and IP-based tracking, with integration to Redis and Prisma database.

classes.name: CustomThrottlerGuard
classes.description: A custom rate limiting guard extending ThrottlerGuard, implementing API key, OAuth, and IP-based throttling with Redis caching and database integration.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, determines tracker type, and applies rate limiting accordingly.

methods.name: handleApiEndpointThrottle
methods.description: Applies rate limit to specific API endpoint based on tracker and options.

methods.name: handleApiKeyRequest
methods.description: Handles requests identified by API key, applying multiple rate limits.

methods.name: handleNonApiKeyRequest
methods.description: Handles requests without API key, applying default rate limit.

methods.name: getDefaultRateLimit
methods.description: Returns default rate limit configuration based on tracker.

methods.name: getDefaultLimit
methods.description: Determines default limit value based on tracker prefix.

methods.name: getDefaultTtl
methods.description: Returns default time-to-live for rate limit.

methods.name: getDefaultBlockDuration
methods.description: Returns default block duration for rate limit.

methods.name: getRateLimitsForApiKeyTracker
methods.description: Fetches rate limits for API key tracker from cache or database.

methods.name: incrementRateLimit
methods.description: Increments rate limit counters and sets response headers.

methods.name: getTracker
methods.description: Generates a tracker string based on request authorization headers, IP, or OAuth client ID.
